name: select
description: Best-N view selection over a posed pool, gated behind covis (STO-SCN-094/103). Two objectives: `voxel` (STO-SCN-103, DEFAULT) — voxelize the scene, reward each camera for the exposed voxel faces it observes weighted by incidence-angle flux, greedy-add the largest marginal coverage gain (rewards angular variety, beats track view-spread on the real 001 pool); `track` (STO-SCN-094) — greedy submodular over shared SfM track points (connectivity + triangulation-angle). Emits selection.json (coverage report STO-SCN-095 renders) + posed.json (proposed-N poses) + a content-addressed FINAL-N SUBSET (member hashes) consumed unchanged by the reconstruct graphs via `--subset <final> --sfm unposed/posed` (STO-SCN-095 handoff). Runs locally on the store's sparse/0. Lives under the solve.

selector.note: voxel (STO-SCN-103 coverage flux, default) | track (STO-SCN-094 covisibility)

n.note: target view count (downstream model's sweet spot; ~12-17 reconstruct graphs, ~32 DA3)

min_overlap.note: connectivity: shared pts a kept view must share with the selected set (track selector)

div_angle.note: viewpoint-diversity: penalize same-space views within this optical-axis angle (track selector; 0 = off)
